verdict.rationale: Cline is a built-in AI coding assistant embedded directly in editors (VS Code, JetBrains, Cursor, etc.) and CLI that can be delegated tasks—creating files, running commands, autonomous execution, and multi-agent parallelism—corroborated by extensive first-party docs and strong hands-on community praise calling it 'the most effective agentic coding tool.' Missing for 10: broader independent benchmark validation beyond forum anecdotes.
